description.value: Edo Japan Country Club Centre is a Canadian-founded, Japanese-inspired fast-food franchise serving teppanyaki, hand-rolled sushi, bubble tea, and ramen from a mall food-court unit in Nanaimo. Founded in Calgary in 1979, the chain now has more than 200 locations nationwide and offers dine-in seating, take-out, delivery, and catering. It's a practical stop for a hot, filling meal on a ride through the Island Highway corridor.

address.value: #103, 3250 Island Hwy N, Nanaimo, British Columbia

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 27m; rack at 70m.
